title: A Vision of a Golden Lampstand

questions.question: And the angel who talked with me came again and woke me, like a man who is wakened out of his...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:1 (ESV): "And the angel who talked with me came again and woke me, like a man who is wakened out of his sleep."

questions.question: And he said to me, "What do you see?" I said, "I see, and behold, a lampstand all of..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:2 (ESV): "I said, 'I see, and behold, a lampstand all of gold,'"

questions.question: What was on the top of the golden lampstand?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:2 (ESV): "with a bowl on the top of it,"

questions.question: How many lamps were on the lampstand?
What was by the lampstand, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:3 (ESV): "And there are two olive trees by it, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left."

questions.question: Then he said to me, "This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel: Not by might, nor by power, but by my..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:6 (ESV): "Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the Lord of hosts."

questions.question: "Who are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you shall become a..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:7 (ESV): "Who are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you shall become a plain."

questions.question: "And he shall bring forward the top stone amid shouts of..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:7 (ESV): "And he shall bring forward the top stone amid shouts of 'Grace, grace to it!'"

questions.question: "The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:9 (ESV): "The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also complete it."

questions.question: "For whoever has despised the day of..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:10 (ESV): "For whoever has despised the day of small things shall rejoice,"

questions.question: What do the seven lamps represent, which "range through the whole earth"?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:10 (ESV): "These seven are the eyes of the Lord, which range through the whole earth."

questions.question: Then I said to him, "What are these two olive trees on the right and the left of the lampstand?" ...Then he said, "These are the two..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:14 (ESV): "Then he said, 'These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.'"

questions.question: The two anointed ones, represented by the olive trees, stand by the...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:14 (ESV): "who stand by the Lord of the whole earth."

questions.question: How many lips were on each of the lamps on the golden lampstand?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:2 (ESV): "with seven lips on each of the lamps that are on the top of it."

questions.question: What emptied from the two branches of the olive trees into the golden pipes?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 4:12 (ESV): "which empty out the golden oil from themselves?"
